newsitem.title: USA: A.H. Belo sells $750 mln in three-part deal.
newsitem.headline: A.H. Belo sells $750 mln in three-part deal.

text.p: The following three-tranche debt deal from A.H. Belo Corp was priced on Tuesday via Morgan Stanley & Co, according to a market source.
A.H. Belo publishes the Dallas Morning News as well as other newspapers and owns seven network television stations
